html.description: Email body as HTML, stored as sent. Supports Liquid, such as `{{ variables.first_name }}`.

key.description: Key of the template, chosen by you. Letters, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (_), at most 400 characters. The same key names the template in every project.

name.description: Template name shown in the template library.

preheader.description: Inbox preview text shown after the subject. Leaving it out removes the stored one.

source.description: Where the template file lives, so people in PostHog can find it. Leaving it out, or a part of it, keeps what is stored.

path.description: Path of the template file in the repository, such as `emails/welcome.html`.

ref.description: Commit or branch the file was uploaded from.

repository.description: Host and path of the repository the file is in, such as `github.com/example/app`.

subject.description: Email subject line. Supports Liquid, such as `{{ variables.first_name }}`.

text.description: Plain-text body for email clients that can't show HTML. Leaving it out removes the stored one.
